issues.issue: Brânză is the ordinary concrete dairy food, not an abstract theme. Fourteen recognizable direct predecessors include milk, telemea, urdă, cașcaval, familiar cheese-filled preparations and the variant-qualified coagulant. Dictionaries define the milk-derived food; named Pască/Poale-n brâu recipes support the familiar use associations. Different cheese types need not share salt, color or one coagulant. Fresh generic target is distinct from already served Telemea/Urdă.

Lapte is an ordinary concrete food with a dominant culinary sense. Fourteen recognizable direct predecessors include dairy products, a glass, ice cream and familiar school/family-food contexts. The new freezer predecessor expressly covers selected milk variants and does not promise unchanged texture for every milk. Powdered milk remains a separate processed identity; no health, infant-formula or universal-animal-origin claim is introduced.

Savarină is a familiar soaked pastry with whipped cream, supported by the original2013 JamilaCuisine recipe. Five current direct predecessors are Amandină, Ecler, Desert, Prăjitură and the new defining Frișcă ingredient. The concrete cofetărie name is distinct from all existing Contexto targets. Its low0.55 graph salience requires a separate easy-band judgment, not invented additional obscurity.

Frișcă names the familiar aerated cream topping. Original Hendi preparation guidance and the tested Chantilly recipe support all five incoming clues: suitable sweet cream, refrigerator storage, vanilla, powdered sugar and a kitchen mixer. Sugar, vanilla and machine use are optional variants. The group does not imply fermented sour cream always whips, refrigeration alone makes cream, or plain industrial mixer is a culinary exact alias.

Cremă de vanilie is a concrete recognizable pastry filling. The original Dr.Oetker recipe explicitly names milk, sugar, vanilla pod, culinary starch and yolks, matching all five incoming clues. Actual eclair recipes corroborate use as a filling. These are recipe variants; not every vanilla cream contains eggs or starch. The compound target is not synonymous with its vanilla ingredient.

The actual directed graph gives Frigider→Frișcă→Înghețată and Frigider→Congelator→Înghețată, each two links, with two first hops and no intermediate choke. Hendi supports chilled whipped cream; Auchan uses it in a frozen ice-cream base. The original Beko manual distinguishes refrigerator and freezer compartments and places ice cream in frozen storage. Some complete fridge-freezer appliances are colloquially called frigider, so the two-link optimal is a graph-path count, not proof that an appliance called a fridge cannot store ice cream. The authored compartment qualifier makes the route factually defensible; final D2/D4 fairness review must retain that language ambiguity as a limitation.
